videos.script: Joana's rule for coupons is one sentence. The code PIPOCA takes five reais off an order. {{rule}} Rafael starts with a test, before any code. It fails, because there is no code. That is red. {{red}} Then the least code that passes. Return thirty-one reais, always. Green. {{green}} It looks like cheating, and it is useful. Lia asks: so every code gives five reais off? That becomes the next test, and it fails. {{fake}} Each new example forces the code to stop guessing. An unknown code. A lowercase code. A code pasted with spaces around it. {{examples}} With the tests green, the code can be reshaped safely. That is refactoring. {{refactor}} And the questions nobody asked, two coupons, a Wednesday, have no test at all. A green suite records the questions that were asked. Asking the rest is the tester's job. {{end}}
